title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement: How many whole numbers between \(100\) and \(400\) contain the digit \(2?\)

solutions.text:
All \(100\) numbers from \(200\) to \(299\) contain a \(2.\)

Among \(100\) to \(199,\) there are \(10\) with a \(2\) in the tens place and \(10\) with a \(2\) in the units place, but \(122\) is counted twice, giving \(10 + 10 - 1 = 19.\) The range \(300\) to \(399\) similarly contributes \(19.\)

The total is \(100 + 19 + 19 = 138.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Every number from \(200\) to \(299\) already contains a \(2\)
For \(100\)–\(199\) and \(300\)–\(399,\) count those with a \(2\) in the tens or units place, subtracting the ones counted twice
